c.tagline: Habsburg-era coffee capital of western Ukraine, all cobblestones and cathedrals.

taxi.fareNote: Use ride-hailing apps (Uklon, Bolt, Uber) or a dispatch service — street taxis rarely use meters and may overcharge.

emergency.note: 112 is the general emergency number connecting to police, ambulance, and fire; 102 reaches the police and 103 the ambulance directly.

avoid.reason: No no-go districts as such, but heed air-raid alerts and keep clear of military and infrastructure sites given the ongoing war.
Pickpocketing in Rynok Square crowds and at the train station, and note the wartime curfew (roughly midnight–5am).

hood_desc: The UNESCO-listed historic core around the Market Square (Ploshcha Rynok), all cobblestones, cathedrals, and centuries-old coffee houses; the best walkable base for first-time visitors.
The prosperous central district holding the fanciest hotels alongside quirky cafes, cellar bars, and reasonably priced restaurants; the hub for dining and going out.
A leafy, historic district built around the famous Lychakiv Cemetery and its parks; calm and green, ideal for history buffs and a slower pace.
A lively cultural quarter near Prospekt Svobody, close to theaters, museums, and the Opera House; an arty, buzzy feel just outside the oldest streets.
A working-class district northeast of the center below the High Castle (Vysokyi Zamok) hill; local, residential, and budget-friendly.

water.note: Tap water is not reliably potable; drink bottled or filtered.

transit.hours: Trams, trolleybuses, and marshrutka minibuses run roughly 5:30am-11pm; a few night routes cover the small hours, but taxis or ride apps fill most late-night gaps.
transit.note: Lviv has no metro; getting around relies on an extensive tram, trolleybus, and marshrutka (minibus) network, plus taxis and ride apps.
transit.pay: Pay the driver or conductor in cash on board, or tap a contactless card on newer trams and trolleybuses; a single ride is about 15 UAH (~$0.37). Keep small change handy for marshrutkas.

air: Lviv Danylo Halytskyi International Airport (LWO) — reduced air service since 2022; check current operations
bus: Dvirtseva bus station near the main railway station

transit.m: Trolleybus 29 to the city center (~30 min)
Marshrutka 48 toward the railway station and center

tip.r: Not obligatory; rounding up or leaving about 10% for good service in restaurants is appreciated.
